standard: A station is only 'verified' when ChargeSetu's review team has confirmed it with the operator or on site. Online listings, news and directories are evidence of existence, not of current operation. Nothing here is marked verified, and nothing here is published.
limits: Operator apps and locators (Jio-bp, Tata Power EZ Charge, Bolt.Earth, GoGreen, GreenShift) cannot be read by automated tools, so station-level operator confirmation was not possible for those networks.
Tesla and PlugShare pages blocked automated access; only their search-result text was seen.
Google Maps was not accessible. OpenStreetMap has only 9 charging points in the Mumbai / Navi Mumbai area searched and none lists connectors or hours.
NITI Aayog's E-Amrit station database was not used because its owner asks for prior permission before use.
Ather's PDF and the MSEDCL article are undated; neither proves a charger works today.
